hero.subtitle: PRECIA is an integrated clinical AI platform that accelerates medical decision-making with intelligent, data-driven insights.

real_time.label: AI inference
real_time.description: Our AI inference engine processes clinical data in milliseconds, enabling physicians to receive instant diagnostic suggestions and treatment recommendations powered by state-of-the-art neural networks.

multi_model.label: AI registry
multi_model.description: Access a curated registry of specialized medical AI models from radiology analysis to pathology classification, all validated against clinical benchmarks and seamlessly integrated into your workflow.

multi_unit.label: governance
multi_unit.description: Manage clinical governance across departments, facilities, and regions with unified dashboards that aggregate quality metrics while respecting each unit's unique compliance requirements.

full_audit.label: audit trail
full_audit.description: Every decision, annotation, and model prediction is immutably logged with timestamps and user attribution, ensuring complete transparency for regulatory audits and continuous improvement.

modules.title: Specialized AI for every
modules.subtitle: Each module is meticulously trained on department-specific clinical data, delivering precision diagnostics and intelligent decision support tailored to your specialty.

CARD.name: Cardiology
CARD.description: AI-powered cardiac analysis with real-time ECG interpretation, arrhythmia detection, and heart failure risk stratification. Our deep learning models analyze echocardiograms and cardiac MRI with cardiologist-level accuracy.

DENT.name: Dentistry
DENT.description: Intelligent dental imaging analysis with automated caries detection, periodontal assessment, and treatment planning. AI-assisted panoramic and CBCT scan interpretation for comprehensive oral diagnostics.

EMER.name: Emergency
EMER.description: Rapid triage AI that prioritizes critical patients using vital sign patterns, symptom clustering, and predictive deterioration scoring. Reduces door-to-treatment time with intelligent clinical pathways.

SURG.name: General Surgery
SURG.description: Pre-operative risk assessment and surgical planning AI. Analyzes patient history, imaging data, and comorbidities to predict outcomes and recommend optimal surgical approaches.

ICU.name: Intensive Care Unit
ICU.description: Continuous monitoring AI for critical care environments. Real-time analysis of multi-parameter vital signs, ventilator management, and early warning systems for clinical deterioration.

NEUR.name: Neurology
NEUR.description: Advanced neural imaging analysis and EEG interpretation. AI-powered stroke detection, seizure classification, and neurodegenerative disease progression tracking with millisecond precision.

ONCO.name: Oncology
ONCO.description: Precision oncology AI for tumor classification, treatment response prediction, and personalized therapy recommendations. Integrates genomic data with imaging for comprehensive cancer intelligence.

ORTH.name: Orthopedics
ORTH.description: AI-driven musculoskeletal imaging analysis with automated fracture detection, joint degeneration scoring, and surgical planning. Provides 3D reconstruction and implant size recommendation.

PEDI.name: Pediatrics
PEDI.description: Child-specific AI models calibrated for pediatric physiology. Growth trajectory analysis, developmental milestone tracking, and age-adjusted diagnostic support for neonatal to adolescent care.

RADI.name: Radiology
RADI.description: State-of-the-art medical imaging AI covering X-ray, CT, MRI, and ultrasound modalities. Automated detection of abnormalities, structured reporting, and priority flagging for critical findings.

URO.name: Urology
URO.description: Intelligent urological diagnostics with AI-assisted imaging interpretation for kidney, bladder, and prostate conditions. Automated stone analysis, PSA pattern recognition, and renal function prediction.

benefits.subtitle: A mature technical foundation that transforms medical AI innovation from prototype to real-world clinical solutions with measurable impact.

01.title: Standardized Clinical Integration
01.description: Eliminate technical barriers by unifying multiple medical AI models into a single ecosystem. PRECIA removes the need to build separate applications, enabling seamless integration directly into clinical workflows at hospitals that are IT-ready.

02.title: Data Security & Full Auditability
02.description: Dealing with sensitive patient data requires bank-grade security. PRECIA features end-to-end encryption, strict Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), and detailed audit trails ensuring every analytical step is traceable and accountable.

03.title: Modular & Flexible Architecture
03.description: Built with an API-first approach, PRECIA offers the freedom to toggle AI modules on or off based on institutional needs. Integrating new capabilities like EHR analytics becomes highly agile and non-disruptive.

04.title: Flexible Deployment Options
04.description: Deploy on-premise for maximum data sovereignty or leverage hybrid-cloud infrastructure for unmatched scalability, balancing regulatory compliance with computational power.

05.title: Bridging Research Into Real-World Solutions
05.description: Accelerate the transition from academic medical AI research into viable clinical products. PRECIA provides the necessary operational backbone, drastically reducing Go-To-Market time for healthcare innovators.
